Name: Stay on the Farm
Author: Nikolayevsk
Description:
[b][size=6]Stay on the Farm![/size][/b]
[heading][size=5]Description[/size][/heading]
[size=3][b]Stay on the Farm![/b] lets you choose which spouses should remain on your farm instead of following their regular married schedules around Pelican Town.
Maybe you want your favorite spouse around more often. Maybe you have multiple spouses and want everyone together at home. Or maybe you simply think there's no reason for them to leave.
After all, everything they need is already on the farm... including you. ❤️
The mod doesn't change relationships, marriage mechanics, dialogue, heart levels, spouse rooms, or events. It simply prevents selected spouses from following their regular weekday marriage schedules outside the farm.
It works with a normal vanilla marriage and is also designed to work alongside polyamory/multiple-spouse mods that use Stardew Valley's standard NPC schedule system.[/size]
[heading][line]
[size=5]Installation[/size][/heading]
[list=1]
[*]Install [b]SMAPI[/b].[/*]
[*]Install [b]Content Patcher[/b].[/*]
[*]Download [b]Stay on the Farm![/b][/*]
[*]Extract the mod into your
[code]Stardew Valley/Mods[/code]folder.[/*]
[*]Launch Stardew Valley through SMAPI.[/*]
[*]Select which spouses should stay on the farm.[/*]
[/list]For easier configuration, you can optionally install [b]Generic Mod Config Menu (GMCM)[/b] and change the settings directly in-game.
Without GMCM, the mod can still be configured through its generated
[code]config.json[/code]file.
To uninstall, simply remove the mod folder. The mod doesn't permanently modify your save.
[heading][line]
[size=5]Main Features[/size][/heading]
[list]
[*]Individual configuration for every vanilla marriage candidate.[/*]
[*]Supports [b]Abigail, Alex, Elliott, Emily, Haley, Harvey, Leah, Maru, Penny, Sam, Sebastian and Shane[/b].[/*]
[*]Optional support for [b]Krobus[/b] as a roommate.[/*]
[*]Choose exactly which characters should stay on the farm.[/*]
[*]Works with Stardew Valley's normal single-spouse marriage.[/*]
[*]Designed to work with multiple-spouse/polyamory mods that use the standard NPC schedule system.[/*]
[*]Optional in-game configuration through [b]Generic Mod Config Menu[/b].[/*]
[*]Does not change dialogue, relationships, heart levels, spouse rooms or marriage mechanics.[/*]
[*]Does not affect festivals.[/*]
[*]Does not affect Green Rain.[/*]
[*]Does not affect scripted events or cutscenes.[/*]
[*]Does not affect special date-specific schedules.[/*]
[*]Does not permanently modify your save.[/*]
[*]English and Brazilian Portuguese configuration included.[/*]
[*]Disabling a character's option allows their normal schedule to be used again.[/*]
[/list]The mod focuses specifically on regular married weekday routines. Your spouses are still NPCs and can participate normally in festivals, events and other special situations.
[heading][line]
[size=5]Requirements[/size][/heading]
Required
[b]SMAPI[/b]
Required to load Stardew Valley mods.
[b]Content Patcher[/b]
Stay on the Farm! is a Content Patcher content pack and requires it to work.
Optional
[b]Generic Mod Config Menu (GMCM)[/b]
Recommended for easily choosing which spouses should stay on the farm through an in-game configuration menu.
GMCM is not required for the mod to function.
[b]Polyamory mods[/b]
A polyamory mod is not required.
Stay on the Farm! works perfectly fine with Stardew Valley's normal marriage system. It is also designed to coexist with polyamory/multiple-spouse mods as long as those mods continue using the game's standard NPC schedule assets.
[heading][line]
